studies.answer: PHAST-UNKNOWN has the lowest mean forecast error in 40/40 matched cells, but its paired 95% seed interval resolves the advantage in 16/40. Bounded PHAST recovers more than a constant mean-damping law in 14/40 cells, while the spectral bound improves over the uncapped model in 40/40. Increasing N from 32 to 512 improves forecast in 8/8 and recovery in 8/8 fixed-T comparisons; increasing T from 120 to 320 degrades recovery in 10/10. At equal NT, more, shorter trajectories improve forecast in 12/16 and recovery in 16/16 comparisons.
studies.evidence: 40 matched data cells across two motion ranges, five trajectory counts, and four trajectory lengths; five model seeds per method, fixed data seed 42, and the same full 320-sample validation and test trajectories in every cell.

execution.summary: Both five-seed N by T surfaces are complete.

studies.motivates: Experiments that acquire information about the ambiguous physical direction rather than merely collecting more similar samples.
studies.not_established: A positive damping R-squared shows recovery relative to a constant mean law; it does not prove unique identification of potential, mass, and damping from positions. The study uses one passive plant and one data seed. Because epochs are fixed, the N effect is not isolated from optimizer updates or wall time; sampling-rate, forced-motion, dimensional, and general-identifiability claims remain open.

studies.answer: No from the training transition law alone. The thermal and external-source hypotheses have identical total drift and covariance before intervention. Removing the external channel separates them.
studies.evidence: Four source-isolation cells; 40 probe-seed pairs per cell. Maximum covariance error is 0.68%; maximum drift and discrete-energy deviations are below 2.86 standard errors.

studies.label: Uncertainty

matched_law.answer: The training transition law does not identify whether covariance is thermal or externally supplied; removing the external channel does.

studies.motivates: Interventions or independently calibrated channels before claiming that a learned stochastic term identifies a physical noise source.
studies.not_established: No learned model has yet recovered this decomposition from q-only data, and no long-horizon calibration claim is made.
